# Home and Garage Organization Pack

Organize around retrieval and return, not appearance alone. Give frequently used tools and supplies stable homes close to where they are used. Label zones, keep like items together, record consumables and create a small project queue rather than attempting the whole property at once.

Kevin should identify misplaced items, duplicate purchases, low-stock consumables, maintenance due dates and projects blocked by missing supplies. Kevin may prepare labels, lists and shopping recommendations but may not purchase or discard property without Matt's approval.
